CALCULATOR

Enter an expression after calc> and press Enter or ↵.

Continue a result
5 + 5 → 10
+5 → 15
*2 → 30
A leading +, −, ×, ÷ or ^ continues the last successful result. A complete expression starts fresh. Use (-5) for a standalone negative value after a result. Errors and cancellation keep the last result.

Arithmetic
2 + 3 * 4 → 14
(2 + 3) * 4 → 20
sqrt(144) → 12
2^3 → 8

Convert units
5 ft to cm → 152.4 cm
*2 → 304.8 cm
ans to ft → 10 ft
Use to for conversion. The word in means inches.

Explicit answers and variables
ans is optional: sqrt(ans), 100 / ans and ans to ft refer to the last result. ans = 5 sets it. Named assignments such as tax = 18% go to Qalculate; these variables last only while the engine process remains alive.

Keypad and editing
123: numbers, operators and =
ABC: letters, units and variable names
FUNC: functions, constants and =
Tap the input to place the cursor or select text. Function keys insert parentheses with the cursor inside. ⌫ deletes. = inserts an assignment; ↵ evaluates.

Commands
clear — clear the transcript, keeping the last result
help — open the calculator guide
exit — close the calculator

Cancel stops the current calculation. Back closes Help and retains your reading position.

FUNCTIONS / CONSTANTS

sqrt(9) → 3
sin(90) → 1 in degrees mode
FUNC inserts sqrt, sin, cos, tan, log, ln and abs with parentheses. Constants: pi and e.

CONVERSIONS

5 ft to miles
20 celsius to fahrenheit
Use to for conversion. The word in means inches. ABC enters letters and units.

CONTINUE A RESULT

5 + 5 → 10
+5 → 15
*2 → 30

Start with an operator to use the last successful result automatically. A complete expression starts fresh; (-5) enters a standalone negative value after a result.

ans is optional for explicit references such as sqrt(ans), 100 / ans or ans to ft. ans = 5 sets it. Errors and cancellation keep the last result. Clear keeps it too.

KEYPAD / EDITING

123: numbers, operators and =
ABC: letters and units
FUNC: functions, constants and =

Tap the prompt to place the cursor or select text. Function keys, including sqrt, insert parentheses with the cursor inside. ⌫ deletes the selection or previous character. ↵ evaluates.
